timeline.summary: Biocon Limited’s **Rajesh Umakant Shanoy** declared no encumbrance on Syngene International shares by promoters or PAC as of March 31, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,036.5 Cr (+1.8% YoY), net profit ₹147.9 Cr (-19.3% YoY).
Syngene reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹1,037 Cr and full-year revenue of ₹3,739 Cr (+3% YoY); alongside leadership changes.
Syngene International announced that Mr. Siddharth Mittal will succeed Mr. Peter Bains as Managing Director & CEO effective July 01, 2026.
Syngene International reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹1,037 Cr (+2% YoY) and announced leadership changes including Siddharth Mittal as incoming CEO.
Syngene International Limited shared the Q4 FY26 earnings call audio recording on April 30, 2026, via its website.
Syngene International announced the board's approval for the voluntary liquidation of its inactive wholly owned subsidiary, Syngene Manufacturing Solutions Limited.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹832.7 Cr (-8.6% YoY), net profit ₹32.2 Cr (-52.0% YoY).
Syngene International reported Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹833 Cr and PAT of ₹32 Cr.
Syngene published its Q2FY27 investor presentation detailing first manufacturing win at Bayview facility and cost optimization actions.
Syngene International Limited, via **CHETHAN YOGESH**, shared Q2 FY27 earnings call audio recording on October 28, 2026.
